# assets/third_party — art made by other people

One folder per pack, kept **as downloaded** (original names). Our own picks, tile sets and edits go
elsewhere, so a pack can be updated by replacing its folder.

| Folder | Pack | Author | License (short) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pixel_crawler/` | Pixel Crawler — Free Pack 2.11 | Anokolisa | Commercial use OK, credit not required, may edit; **may not resell the art itself**. Full text: `pixel_crawler/Terms.txt` | https://anokolisa.itch.io/free-pixel-art-asset-pack-topdown-tileset-rpg-16x16-sprites |

Ground tiles, tagged: [docs/wiki/ground-tiles.md](../../docs/wiki/ground-tiles.md).
